# G Pen Product Guides: full text

Source: https://help.gpen.com/ (official G Pen help site). Support: +1 833-691-3224, help@gpen.com.

## G Pen Hydout (510 Cartridge Battery)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/hydout/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug any USB-C cable into the port on the base.
    - Pass-through charging: you can use it while it charges.
    - The display shows battery level while charging.
    - Give it a full charge before first use.
    - Note: USB-C cable not included.
2. **Load**
    - Pull off the magnetic mouthpiece cover.
    - Screw in your 510 cartridge: snug, not cranked.
    - Snap the cover back on.
    - Note: Fits most 510-thread cartridges up to 2 g. Cartridge sold separately.
3. **Activate**
    - Turn on (5x): Five quick presses
    - Adjust voltage (3x): Cycles 2.4V → 2.8V → 3.2V → 3.6V → 3.8V
    - 10-second preheat (2x): Warms oil at 1.8V
    - Activate + draw (hold): Hold the button or just inhale
    - Turn off (5x): Auto shut-off after 10 minutes
    - Note: Lower voltage = more flavor. Higher = bigger clouds.
4. **Clean**
    - Turn it off and remove the cartridge first.
    - Use a cotton swab + isopropyl alcohol (ISO).
    - Wipe the inside of the mouthpiece cover.
    - Wipe the cartridge connection point.
    - Let dry fully before reloading.
    - Note: Never soak the battery in alcohol or any liquid.

### Specs

- Battery: 400 mAh
- Charging: USB-C
- Heat settings: 5 · 2.4V / 2.8V / 3.2V / 3.6V / 3.8V
- Preheat: 1.8V · 10 seconds
- Auto shut-off: 10 minutes
- Compatibility: 510-thread carts up to 2 g
- Display: LED · voltage and battery level
- Dimensions: 90 × 37.5 × 18.5 mm
- Weight: 50 g
- SKU: GHO-001-AOZZ
- UPC: 811736029254
- Warranty: 90-Day Limited Warranty

### Common questions

**Nothing happens when I press the button**

The device auto-sleeps after 10 minutes. Press five times to wake it. If the display still doesn't light up, charge it and try again.

**My cart isn't producing vapor**

Make sure the cartridge is threaded in snugly, not over-tightened. Try a double-press for a 10-second preheat to loosen thick oil, then draw again: hold the button or just inhale.

**Which heat setting should I use?**

Start low. Lower voltages give more flavor and make a cart last longer; higher voltages give bigger, warmer clouds. Press three times to cycle through the five settings.

**Will my cartridge fit?**

The Hydout takes standard 510-thread cartridges up to 2 g. Very wide or extra-tall carts may keep the magnetic cover from seating flush.

**How do I know when it's fully charged?**

The LED display shows the battery level. Leave it on the cable until it reads full.

**What does the warranty cover?**

The Hydout comes with a 90-Day Limited Warranty. Register your device and read the full terms on gpen.com, or contact support with your order details.


## G Pen Dash II (Dry Herb Vaporizer)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/dash-ii/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug any USB-C cable into the port on the device.
    - Give it a full charge before first use.
    - Note: USB-C cable not included.
2. **Load**
    - Remove the magnetic mouthpiece.
    - Fully load the chamber with ground dry herb.
    - Pack lightly with the included pick tool. Do not overpack.
    - Re-attach the mouthpiece before powering on.
    - Note: ~0.4 g capacity. A proper pack allows airflow. Overpacking restricts draws and reduces vapor quality.
3. **Activate**
    - Power on (hold): Hold button 3 seconds
    - Turn off (hold): Press and hold the center button
    - Adjust temperature (+/−): Use + and − buttons
    - Start session (2x): Double-tap within 2 seconds · vibrates 3 times when ready
    - Inhale from mouthpiece (draw): Long, sustained draws work best
    - Cancel session (2x): Double-tap anytime to stop
    - Device settings (5x): Five quick presses
    - Note: Lower temperatures preserve flavor. Higher temperatures produce bigger clouds.
4. **Clean**
    - Clean the mouthpiece filter screen & bowl after every use with the pick tool.
    - Deep clean: remove the mouthpiece insert and clean it with isopropyl alcohol (ISO).
    - Let all parts dry completely before reassembling.
    - Note: Never soak the battery in alcohol or any liquid.

### Specs

- Type: Dry Herb Vaporizer
- Battery: 1,100 mAh
- Chamber: 0.4 g ceramic
- Charging: USB-C
- Temperature: 370°F – 430°F (187°C – 221°C) · adjust with + / −
- Session mode: Double-tap to start / cancel · 2 min / 3 min / 4 min
- Haptic feedback: Yes
- Included: Pick tool, mouthpiece insert
- Dimensions: 97 × 35 × 21 mm
- Weight: 59.5 g
- SKU: GPD-001-APZZ
- UPC: 852570004441
- Warranty: 6-Month Limited Warranty (1-Year with registration)

### Common questions

**How do I turn it on?**

Hold the main button for 3 seconds. The device will vibrate and the display will turn on, indicating it is powered up and ready.

**How do I start a session?**

Once the device is on, set your temperature and double-tap the button within 2 seconds to start a session. It vibrates three times when it's heated and ready. Double-tap again anytime to cancel it early.

**My vapor tastes burnt. What's wrong?**

You may have the temperature too high, or the bowl may need cleaning. Try a lower temperature setting and clean the screen and bowl with the pick tool after each session.

**How tight should I pack the chamber?**

Pack firmly enough that material won't fall out but loose enough that you can draw air through easily. Overpacking restricts airflow and reduces vapor production.

**How do I deep clean the mouthpiece?**

Remove the mouthpiece insert and soak or wipe it with isopropyl alcohol (ISO). Let it dry completely before reassembling and using the device.

**What does the warranty cover?**

The Dash II comes with a 6-Month Limited Warranty, or a 1-Year Limited Warranty when you register your device at gpen.com. Read the full terms on gpen.com, or contact support with your order details.


## G Pen 510 Original (510 Cartridge Battery)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/510-original/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug any USB-C cable into the charging port.
    - Pass-through charging: you can use it while it charges.
    - Give it a full charge before first use.
    - Note: USB-C cable not included.
2. **Load**
    - Screw in your 510 cartridge: snug, not cranked.
    - Note: Fits standard 510-thread cartridges. Cartridge sold separately.
3. **Activate**
    - Turn on (5x): Five quick presses
    - Adjust voltage (3x): 1 cloud = 3.2V (low) · 2 = 3.6V (medium) · 3 = 3.8V (high)
    - 10-second preheat (2x): Warms oil at 1.8V
    - Activate + draw (hold): Hold button or breathe in to activate
    - Turn off (5x): Auto shut-off after 10 minutes
    - Note: Lower voltage = more flavor. Higher = bigger clouds.
4. **Clean**
    - Turn it off and remove the cartridge first.
    - Use a cotton swab + isopropyl alcohol (ISO).
    - Clean the inside of the battery/cartridge connection point.
    - Let dry fully before reloading.
    - Note: Never soak the battery in alcohol or any liquid.

### Specs

- Type: 510 Cartridge Battery
- Battery: 400 mAh
- Charging: USB-C
- Voltage settings: 3 · 3.2V / 3.6V / 3.8V
- Preheat: 1.8V · 10 seconds
- Auto shut-off: 10 minutes
- Compatibility: Standard 510-thread cartridges
- Dimensions: 24 × 21.1 × 56.7 mm
- Weight: 30 g
- SKU: GSB-001-AOZZ
- UPC: 811736029742
- Warranty: 90-Day Limited Warranty

### Common questions

**Nothing happens when I press the button**

Press the button five times quickly to power the device on. The LED will light up to confirm it is on. If the LED still doesn't respond, charge the device and try again.

**My cart isn't producing vapor**

Make sure the cartridge is threaded in snugly, not over-tightened. Try double-pressing for a 10-second preheat to loosen thick oil, then hold the button or draw to activate.

**Which voltage should I use?**

Start at 3.2V for the most flavor-forward experience. Step up to 3.6V or 3.8V for bigger, warmer clouds. Press three times to cycle through the three settings.

**Will my cartridge fit?**

The 510 Original accepts standard 510-thread cartridges. Very wide or extra-tall carts may not fit flush.

**What does the warranty cover?**

The 510 Original comes with a 90-Day Limited Warranty. Register your device and read the full terms on gpen.com, or contact support with your order details.


## G Pen Micro II (Concentrate Vaporizer)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/micro-ii/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug any USB-C cable into the port on the device.
    - Give it a full charge before first use.
    - Note: USB-C cable not included.
2. **Load**
    - Remove the mouthpiece to access the ceramic heating chamber.
    - Load the chamber with your concentrate. Do not overfill.
    - Note: A small amount of concentrate goes a long way. Overfilling can clog the chamber and reduce airflow.
3. **Activate**
    - Turn on (5x): Five quick presses
    - Adjust temperature (3x): 1 cloud = ~295°F (low) · 2 = ~340°F (medium) · 3 = ~395°F (high)
    - Start session mode (2x): Double-tap to begin a 20-second cycle
    - Cancel session mode (2x): Double-tap again to stop early
    - Manual heat (hold): Hold to heat while you draw, up to 25 seconds
    - Turn off (5x): Auto shut-off after 10 minutes
    - Note: Lower temperatures preserve flavor terpenes. Higher temperatures produce bigger, more intense vapor.
4. **Clean**
    - Allow the device to completely cool before cleaning.
    - Use a cotton swab + isopropyl alcohol (ISO).
    - Clean inside the ceramic heating chamber and the mouthpiece, and make sure the air holes are clear.
    - Allow the device to completely dry before using again.
    - Note: Never soak the battery in alcohol or any liquid.
5. **Alerts**
    - G logo flashing = the tank isn't screwed in all the way, or the battery is dead. Screw the tank in firmly; if it keeps flashing, charge the device.
- Attachment, **Sidecar**: Remove the mouthpiece and attach via the included silicone adapter. Control airflow with the built-in carb hole. The showerhead percolator filters and cools vapor for smoother sessions.
- Attachment, **Rig Adapter**: Remove the mouthpiece and attach the Rig Adapter, then connect 14 mm glass to a compatible glass rig. Control airflow with the built-in carb hole. The L-shape design gives maximum flexibility when connected to a rig.

### Specs

- Type: Concentrate Vaporizer
- Battery: 1,250 mAh
- Charging: USB-C
- Heating element: Ceramic chamber
- Temperature settings: 3 · ~295°F / ~340°F / ~395°F
- Session mode: Double-tap to start / cancel
- Manual mode: Press and hold to activate
- Auto shut-off: 10 minutes
- Compatible attachments: Sidecar, Rig Adapter (14 mm), sold separately
- Dimensions: 98.6 × 24 × 32 mm
- Weight: 86 g
- SKU: GPM-001-APZZ
- UPC: 811736020343
- Warranty: 6-Month Limited Warranty (1-Year with registration)

### Common questions

**Nothing happens when I press the button**

Press the button five times quickly to turn the device on. The LED will light up when it is powered on. If it still doesn't respond, charge the device first.

**Which temperature should I use?**

Start at ~295°F for the most flavorful, terpene-rich experience. Step up to ~340°F for a balance of flavor and vapor. Use ~395°F for maximum vapor production.

**The G logo keeps flashing**

A flashing G logo means the tank isn't screwed in all the way, or the battery is dead. Remove the mouthpiece, screw the tank in firmly, and try again. If it keeps flashing, charge the device. If it still flashes after charging, contact G Pen support.

**How do I use the device with a glass rig?**

Remove the mouthpiece from the Micro II and attach the Rig Adapter (sold separately). Connect 14 mm glass to your compatible glass rig for water-cooled vapor.

**How often should I clean the chamber?**

Clean the ceramic heating chamber after every few sessions to maintain performance. Let the device cool fully, then use a cotton swab with ISO to wipe the chamber and mouthpiece, and dry completely before use.

**What does the warranty cover?**

The Micro II comes with a 6-Month Limited Warranty, or a 1-Year Limited Warranty when you register your device at gpen.com. Read the full terms on gpen.com, or contact support with your order details.


## G Pen Melt (Hot Knife / Dab Tool)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/melt/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug any USB-C cable into the charging port on the bottom.
    - Give it a full charge before first use. It takes about 1 hour.
    - The LED blinks 8 times when the battery is low.
    - Note: Always ready: the Melt supports pass-through charging, so you can use it while it's plugged in. USB-C cable not included.
2. **Power On & Scoop**
    - Click 5 times quickly to power on. The LED lights to confirm.
    - Touch the tip to your concentrate to scoop up a small amount.
    - The device shuts off automatically after 10 minutes of inactivity.
    - Click 5 times again to power off.
    - Power on / off (5x): Click button 5 times quickly
3. **Heat & Drop**
    - Hold the button to heat the ceramic tip. It heats for up to 5 seconds per hold.
    - The tip stays hot for a moment after you let go, so don't touch it.
    - Let your concentrate melt cleanly into your rig, bowl, or device.
    - Works with bangers, e-rigs, and the G Pen Micro II.
    - Heat tip (Hold): Hold to heat, release to stop: 150 °C / 302 °F
4. **Clean**
    - Power it off and let the tip cool completely first.
    - Clean the tip and plastic housing by wiping them with a clean cloth.
    - Clean the plastic connection points on the cap and the base of the tip.
    - Do not soak or submerge the device.
    - Remove excess reclaim with a cotton swab soaked in isopropyl alcohol (ISO).

### Specs

- Type: Electric Hot Knife
- Tip material: Ceramic
- Heat: 150 °C / 302 °F (instant-heat)
- Battery: 160 mAh · 40–50 uses per charge
- Charging: USB-C, ~1 hour (pass-through capable)
- Auto shut-off: 10 minutes
- Dimensions: 3.94" × 0.5" × 0.25"
- Weight: 17 g
- SKU: GHK-001-AOZZ
- UPC: 811736029711
- In the box: Melt hot knife, protective travel cap
- Warranty: 90-Day Limited Warranty

### Common questions

**Nothing happens when I press the button**

Press the button five times quickly to power on. The LED will light up to confirm. If it still doesn't respond, charge the device and try again.

**How do I use the Melt?**

Power it on (5× click), touch the ceramic tip to your concentrate to scoop it up, hold the button to heat, and let it melt cleanly into your device.

**Does the Melt have variable heat?**

No. The Melt uses a precisely tuned heating element optimized for smooth, controlled melting without burning. No settings to adjust.

**Can I use the Melt while it's charging?**

Yes. The Melt supports USB-C pass-through charging: plug it in and keep using it without waiting.

**Is the Melt easy to carry?**

Its compact size (3.94" tall) and the included protective travel cap make it easy to carry, and the 5× click lock prevents accidental activation. Check local laws and airline rules before you travel with it.

**What does the warranty cover?**

The Melt comes with a 90-Day Limited Warranty covering electronics. It does not cover physical damage. Register your device and contact support with your order details.


## G Pen Dash+ (Dry Herb Vaporizer)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/dash-plus/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug any USB-C cable into the charging port on the side.
    - Give it a full charge before first use. It takes about 1 hour.
    - Note: USB-C cable included.
2. **Load**
    - Remove the magnetic mouthpiece.
    - Fully load the titanium chamber with ground dry herb.
    - Pack lightly with the included pick tool. Do not overpack.
    - Re-attach the mouthpiece before powering on.
    - Note: ~0.3 g capacity. A proper pack allows airflow. Overpacking restricts draws and reduces vapor quality.
3. **Activate**
    - Hold the power button for 4 seconds to turn on. The display lights up.
    - Press Left / Right to adjust your target temperature.
    - Double-click to start a session. The device vibrates twice when it reaches temperature (~20 seconds).
    - The session auto-ends when the countdown hits 0:00. The device goes to standby.
    - Power on / off (Hold): Hold 4 seconds to turn on · 2 seconds to turn off
    - Adjust temperature (left/right): Right = increase · Left = decrease
    - Start / cancel session (2x): Double-click the power button
    - Settings menu (5x): Session timer · Temp unit · Brightness · Haptics
4. **Draw**
    - Once the device vibrates, wait 30 seconds for your material to bake, then draw slowly and steadily through the mouthpiece.
    - The spiral ceramic air path cools vapor before it reaches you.
    - The device powers off automatically after 1 minute of no activity.
    - Note: After your session: let the device cool, then remove the mouthpiece and brush out the chamber and mouthpiece filter screen. Regular cleaning keeps flavor and airflow at their best.
5. **Clean**
    - Power it off and let it cool completely first.
    - Dip a cotton swab in isopropyl alcohol (ISO) and squeeze out the excess.
    - Swab around the silicone insert, over the screen, and above and inside the heating chamber.
    - For resin buildup, remove the filter screen and ceramic spiral air path and soak them in ISO.
    - Wipe them with a dry swab and let them air dry before putting them back in the mouthpiece.
    - Note: Never soak the device in alcohol or any liquid.

### Specs

- Type: Dry Herb Vaporizer
- Chamber: ~0.3 g titanium
- Air path: Spiral ceramic (hybrid conduction + convection)
- Heat-up time: ~20 seconds
- Battery: 1,800 mAh
- Charging: USB-C (about 40 minutes of heating per full charge)
- Auto shut-off: 1 minute of inactivity
- Dimensions: 4.3" × 1.6" × 0.8"
- Weight: 276 g
- SKU: GPD-001-AMZZ
- UPC: 811736027489
- Warranty: 2-Year Limited Warranty

### Common questions

**Device won't turn on**

Hold the power button for a full 4 seconds. If nothing happens, charge the device. The battery may be depleted. The LED display lights up when it's on.

**How do I know it's ready to use?**

After you double-click to start a session, the device vibrates twice when it reaches your set temperature. The session countdown then begins on the display.

**Vapor is thin or tastes off**

Try a finer grind and make sure the chamber isn't overpacked. Clean the mouthpiece and air path regularly. Residue buildup is the most common cause of reduced vapor and off flavor.

**What do the error codes mean?**

The Dash+ shows a code when something needs attention. Overheating: turn it off, wait five minutes, and turn it back on. E02 (temperature sensor problem) or E08 (heating coil not connected): contact G Pen support. If the overheating message keeps coming back, contact support too.

**What does the warranty cover?**

The Dash+ comes with a 2-Year Limited Warranty covering electronics and manufacturing defects. Physical damage is not covered.


## G Pen 3-Piece Slim Grinder (Dry Herb Grinder)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/grinder/

### How to use

1. **Open & Load**
    - Remove the magnetic lid.
    - Break up large buds by hand and place them on the teeth in the grinding chamber.
    - Don't overfill. Leave room for the lid to turn freely.
2. **Grind**
    - Replace the lid and twist back and forth about 10 times.
    - Tap the grinder a few times so ground material falls through to the collection chamber.
    - Note: The micro-rounded teeth gently separate flower instead of shredding it, helping preserve terpenes and trichomes.
3. **Collect**
    - Unscrew the bottom chamber to reach your ground material.
    - No kief screen: trichomes and kief stay mixed in with your flower.
    - Load it straight into your Dash II or Dash+.
4. **Clean**
    - Brush leftover material out of the teeth and chambers.
    - For a deeper clean, soak the pieces in isopropyl alcohol (ISO), then rinse with water.
    - Let every piece dry completely before reassembling and using it again.

### Specs

- Type: 3-Piece Dry Herb Grinder
- Teeth: Patented micro-rounded teeth
- Material: 6063 aircraft-grade anodized aluminum
- Kief screen: None, screenless design
- Lid: Magnetic
- Size: 64 mm diameter
- Pairs with: G Pen Dash II, Dash+
- Dimensions: 65 × 65 × 31 mm
- Weight: 110 g
- Patent: No. 11,690,480
- SKU: GPA-001-APSC
- UPC: 811736020688

### Common questions

**Why doesn't it have a kief screen?**

The screenless 3-piece design keeps trichomes and kief mixed in with your ground flower instead of separating them out, so you get all of your flower in every session.

**What makes micro-rounded teeth different?**

Instead of cutting and shredding like sharp teeth, the rounded teeth gently separate flower into a consistent grind. In independent testing by Orange Photonics, the micro-rounded design showed the highest post-grind THC retention of the grinder styles tested.

**The lid is hard to turn**

The chamber is probably overfilled. Remove some flower, break up large buds by hand, and try again. If it still sticks, brush out any buildup around the teeth and threads.

**What grind works best in my Dash II or Dash+?**

An even, consistent grind. About 10 twists and a few taps give you material that loads and heats evenly in the Dash II and Dash+.


## G Pen Elite II (Dry Herb Vaporizer)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/elite-ii/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug any USB-C cable into the charging port on the bottom.
    - Give it a full charge before first use.
    - The battery indicator on the display shows when the battery is low.
2. **Load**
    - Remove the mouthpiece by pulling it straight up.
    - Fill the ceramic oven with ground dry herb. Don't pack tight.
    - Replace the mouthpiece before powering on.
    - Note: Tip: Use the built-in pick tool stored at the base of the device to pack and stir the chamber.
3. **Set & Heat**
    - Hold the power button for 3 seconds to power on. The display lights up.
    - Press + / − to dial in your temperature.
    - Double-click to start a session. The device vibrates twice when it reaches temperature.
    - Power on / off (Hold): Hold the power button for 3 seconds
    - Adjust temperature (+/−): + = increase · − = decrease
    - Start / cancel session (2x): Double-click the power button
    - Settings menu (5x): Brightness · Haptics · °F/°C · Firmware
4. **Draw**
    - Once the device vibrates, draw slowly and steadily through the mouthpiece.
    - Device powers off automatically after 1 minute of inactivity.
    - Note: After your session: Let cool, then use the pick tool to stir the chamber and brush out residue. Regular cleaning keeps flavor at its best.

### Specs

- Type: Dry Herb Vaporizer
- Battery: 2,100 mAh · ~60 minutes of vape time
- Temperature range: 200°F – 430°F (93°C – 221°C)
- Chamber: Ceramic oven
- Charging: USB-C
- Pick tool: Built-in (stored at device base)
- Auto shut-off: 1 minute of inactivity
- Warranty: 2-Year Limited Warranty
- Dimensions: 118 × 30 × 27 mm
- Weight: 146 g
- SKU: GPE-001-AKZZ
- UPC: 811736026154

### Common questions

**Device won't turn on**

Hold the power button for a full 3 seconds. If nothing happens, charge the device. The battery may be depleted.

**How do I know it's ready?**

After double-clicking to start a session, the device vibrates twice when it reaches your set temperature.

**Vapor is thin or tastes off**

Try a finer grind and check that the chamber isn't overpacked. Use the built-in pick tool to stir the load mid-session. Clean the mouthpiece and chamber regularly.

**What does the warranty cover?**

The Elite II comes with a 2-Year Limited Warranty covering electronics and manufacturing defects. Physical damage is not covered.


## G Pen Micro+ (Concentrate Vaporizer)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/micro-plus/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug a USB-C cable into the port on the bottom of the battery.
    - Red LED = charging · Green LED = fully charged.
    - LED flashes 5 times when the battery is low.
2. **Load**
    - Twist off the mouthpiece assembly, then twist off the tank.
    - Add your concentrate to the ceramic chamber inside the tank.
    - Reassemble the tank and mouthpiece before use.
    - Note: Less is more. A small, rice-sized amount of concentrate works best. Overfilling the chamber clogs the airpath.
3. **Set Heat**
    - Click 5 times to power on. The LED lights up.
    - Click 3 times to cycle through heat levels.
    - Power on / off (5x): 5 clicks to power on or off
    - Cycle heat level (3x): Blue = Low · Green = Medium · Red = High
4. **Heat & Draw**
    - The LED flashes then goes solid when the chamber is ready.
    - Draw steadily through the mouthpiece while the LED is solid.
    - Device auto powers off after 5 minutes of inactivity.
    - Manual heat (Hold): Hold button · up to 10 seconds max
    - Auto heat (2x): Double-click · 10 seconds, then stops automatically
    - Note: Hot surface: Do not touch the tank or tank cover for at least 5 minutes after use.

### Specs

- Type: Concentrate Vaporizer
- Battery: 850 mAh
- Chamber: Ceramic
- Heat levels: 3 (Low / Medium / High)
- Max heat duration: 10 seconds
- Auto power-off: 5 minutes of inactivity
- Charging: USB-C
- Thread: 510-compatible battery
- Warranty: 6-Month Limited Warranty (1-Year with registration)
- Package dimensions: 177 × 69 × 42 mm
- Package weight: 190 g
- SKU: GPM-001-AKZZ
- UPC: 811736025362

### Common questions

**Device won't turn on**

Click the button 5 times quickly. If nothing happens, charge the device. The LED will turn red when charging. Make sure the tank is fully twisted onto the battery before trying again.

**Vapor is thin or weak**

Try a higher heat setting. Make sure the concentrate is loaded into the chamber (not on the walls). Clean the tank regularly. Residue buildup on the ceramic reduces efficiency.

**Airflow feels blocked**

Remove the mouthpiece assembly and check for buildup. Soak the mouthpiece in isopropyl alcohol and clean the airpath with a cotton swab. Overfilling the chamber is the most common cause.

**What does the LED flashing 3 times mean?**

Three blinks on startup usually indicates a short circuit or improper tank connection. Remove the tank, clean the connection threads, and reattach firmly.


## G Pen Hyer (Concentrate Vaporizer)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/hyer/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug a USB-C cable into the charging port.
    - Give it a full charge before first use.
    - Press the power button once while off to check battery: 5 LEDs = full, 1 LED = low.
2. **Set Up**
    - Insert the glass adapter end of the Hyer housing into the 14mm female joint of your glass rig.
    - Load concentrate into the bottom of the Concentrates Tank.
    - Place the tank cap on top. Thread your dab tool into the side hole for easy access.
    - Note: 14mm male glass adapter is included. Other adapter sizes sold separately.
3. **Set Heat**
    - Hold the power button for 3 seconds to turn on.
    - Press Left or Right to cycle through the 5 heat levels.
    - Power on / off (Hold): Hold the power button for 3 seconds
    - Heat level (left/right): Blue 482°F · Turquoise · Green · Yellow · Red 842°F
    - Session timer (Hold): Hold both buttons 2s · 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75 sec
    - Sound on / off (3x): 3 clicks to toggle audio notifications
4. **Draw**
    - Double-click the power button to activate a session.
    - Draw through your glass piece while the session runs.
    - Single click or wait for the timer to end the session.
    - Activate session (2x): Double-click to start
    - Increased airflow (Hold): Hold the side button during a session
    - Note: After your session: Wait at least 1 minute, then wipe the quartz chamber with a cotton swab while still warm.

### Specs

- Type: Concentrate Vaporizer
- Battery: 6,000 mAh
- Chamber: Quartz
- Heat levels: 5 (Blue 482°F → Red 842°F)
- Session timer: 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75 seconds
- Battery indicator: 5 LED dots (press power while off)
- Charging: USB-C
- Glass connection: 14mm male adapter (included)
- Warranty: 2-Year Limited Warranty
- Package dimensions: 165 × 137 × 70 mm
- Package weight: 670 g
- SKU: GPH-001-ALZZ
- UPC: 811736026475

### Common questions

**Device won't turn on**

Hold the power button for a full 3 seconds. If nothing happens, charge the device. Press the power button once while off to check the battery level. Only 1 LED lit means it needs a charge.

**How do I check the battery level?**

Press the power button once while the device is off. The 5 LED dots show remaining charge: 1 LED means 0–20%, 5 LEDs means 80–100%.

**Vapor flavor or density is off**

Clean the quartz chamber regularly with a cotton swab after sessions while still warm. Residue buildup is the most common cause of off flavor. Try a lower heat level for a cleaner, more flavorful draw.

**How do I change the session timer?**

While the device is on, hold the Left and Right buttons simultaneously for 2 seconds. Each press cycles through 15, 30, 45, 60, or 75 seconds. The concentrate timer applies to the Concentrates Tank. The dry herb timer cycles separately if you have the dry herb tank attachment.


## G Pen Connect (Concentrate Vaporizer)

Guide: https://help.gpen.com/connect/

### How to use

1. **Charge**
    - Plug a Micro USB cable into the port on the side of the battery housing.
    - Red LED = charging · Green LED = fully charged.
    - LED blinks 8 times when the battery is low.
2. **Set Up**
    - Twist the tank onto the top of the adapter.
    - Twist the male glass adapter onto the bottom of the adapter.
    - Insert the adapter into the 14mm female joint of your water piece.
    - Note: 14mm male adapter fits standard water pieces. Other adapter sizes available separately.
3. **Load**
    - Remove the tank cover and load concentrate onto the ceramic plate inside.
    - Reattach the tank cover.
    - Attach the battery to the tank to complete the connection.
4. **Heat & Draw**
    - Click 5 times to power on. LED lights up in your current voltage color.
    - Draw through your water piece while heating.
    - Power on / off (5x): 5 clicks to power on or off
    - Voltage level (3x): Blue 3.1V · Green 3.6V · Red 4.1V
    - Auto heat (2x): 5s heat-up flash, then 10s max solid heat
    - Manual heat (Hold): Hold button · up to 15 seconds
    - Increased airflow (Side): Hold the side button during a session
    - Note: After consecutive max-heat sessions: Wait at least 2 minutes before touching the tank cover.

### Specs

- Type: Concentrate Vaporizer
- Battery: 850 mAh
- Chamber: Quartz ceramic plate
- Voltage: 3.1V / 3.6V / 4.1V
- Auto heat duration: 5s heat-up + 10s max
- Manual heat duration: Up to 15 seconds
- Charging: Micro USB
- Glass connection: 14mm male adapter (included)
- Warranty: 2-Year Limited Warranty
- Dimensions: 33 × 22.5 × 54.6 mm
- Weight: 99 g
- SKU: GPC-100-AJZZ
- UPC: 811736023986

### Common questions

**Device won't turn on**

Click the button 5 times quickly. Make sure the battery is attached to the tank. The connection must be complete for power to work. If nothing happens, charge the device first.

**LED blinks 3 times on startup**

Three blinks usually means a short circuit or the tank isn't properly connected. Remove the battery, check the tank connection, reattach firmly, and try again.

**Vapor is thin or has poor flavor**

Try a higher voltage setting (3× to cycle). Make sure the concentrate is on the ceramic plate, not the walls of the chamber. Clean the tank regularly. Residue buildup is the most common cause of reduced performance.

**Tank cover is too hot to handle**

This is normal after consecutive max-heat sessions. Wait at least 2 minutes before touching the tank cover. The tank surface is designed to get hot. That's how it vaporizes concentrate efficiently.
